title: Van Allen radiation belt impassable

tellings.quote: Danny brings this up on his podcast where James Van Allen who you know it's named after is saying that is 150 times what a normal human can take radiation wise

plain: The Van Allen belts, zones of radiation circling the Earth, are said by their discoverer James Van Allen to carry about 150 times the radiation a person can normally take. Michels repeats this from the podcaster Danny Jones, who he says raised it on his own show, and he brings in the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun alongside it. If true, it would raise hard questions about how astronauts passed through the belts in the 1960s.
